items.title: Real-Time Voice Control System
items.description: A modern AI-powered voice control system that lets users control a computer, browser, and media players using natural voice commands, powered by OpenAI Whisper and Silero VAD.

items.title: Service Advertising Mobile App
items.description: A Flutter mobile application with Firebase backend that connects customers with service providers. Customers can find, view, bookmark, chat with, and rate service providers.

items.title: AGROW - Smart Agriculture IoT Solution
items.description: AGROW bridges modern technology with agriculture, enabling farmers to monitor soil conditions in real time and receive intelligent fertilizer recommendations through IoT sensors.

items.title: Pomegranate Detection - Flutter Mobile App
items.description: A Flutter mobile app for detecting pomegranate fruits and diagnosing common pomegranate diseases using optimized on-device TensorFlow Lite models for fast local inference.

items.title: Air Quality Display and Management Web Application
items.description: An interactive web application for real-time air quality monitoring in Colombo. Users can view detailed air quality information while administrators manage sensor data and user access.
